title: Prayer in the Church
definition: Prayer in the Church is the gathered and continual dependence of God's people on the Father through Christ by the Holy Spirit.
summary: Prayer in the Church is the congregation's shared dependence on God for mercy, wisdom, power, healing, mission, and perseverance.
christFocus: Jesus Christ gives His people access to the Father and intercedes for them as they pray.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Prayer in the church is the gathered dependence of God's people upon Him. Scripture shows the church praying for boldness, wisdom, healing, leaders, mission, suffering saints, and God's will.

Corporate prayer teaches the church that ministry is not sustained by planning alone. It brings needs, weakness, repentance, praise, and intercession before the Father together.

Jesus gives His people access to the Father and teaches them to pray in faith. The praying church confesses that Christ is Lord and that the work belongs to God.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Churches can become busy without being dependent. Prayer in the church corrects self-reliance and makes space for the weak, burdened, and needy to be carried before God.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Pray with the church, not only for the church. Bring real burdens before God, intercede for others by name, and make prayer central rather than decorative in ministry life.
